text:
noah: Just opened the package — monitor is here but the USB-C cable is missing and the VESA plate is wrong (it came with the tilt plate, I need the articulating arm plate). Also can't join corp-WPA2-Enterprise; it asks for a cert. Ticket #4921
parcel-bot: Delivered by UPS at 9:37 AM. Manifest lists monitor, keyboard, power-cable. No USB-C cable recorded.
Lena (IT): Hi @noah — thanks for flagging. I filed RMA for the missing cable and wrong plate. Shipping for replacement cable and correct VESA plate started (UPS 1Z888BB10123456780). ETA ~2 business days. For Wi-Fi please try the guest onboarding flow: open Safari and go to http://onboard.redwood and follow the device enrollment (certificate will be pushed). If that fails, ping me and I'll create a temporary VPN account.
noah: Tried the onboard page, it 404s. On wired it's fine but my desk is far. macOS Ventura 13.5
Lena (IT): Hmm — thanks. Could you paste output of `networksetup -getinfo Wi-Fi` and `security find-certificate -a -p /Library/Keychains/System.keychain | head -n 20`? Also I've asked infra to check the onboarding service.
noah: networksetup output: DHCP, IP 10.32.45.21, router 10.32.45.1, SSID: corp-WPA2. The cert command is long; gist? But the onboard 404 probably infra. 
jamie (buddy): welcome @noah! I can bring a short ethernet cable and a USB-C cable until IT's replacement shows up if you want. Also have a VESA adapter I used for my monitor.
Lena (IT): Appreciate that, @jamie — we'll mark as temporary loan. Ticket #4921 updated. If onboarding 404 persists after 30m we'll create a VPN creds for you. Thanks for patience :pray:
it-bot: Ticket #4921 updated — replacement parts shipped, tracking 1Z888BB10123456780. Status: awaiting infra check for onboarding portal.
noah: Thanks everyone — laptop + wired is working so I can join standup. I'll reply here if onboarding page still 404s.
Lena (IT): Great. If the cert/errors continue we'll escalate to infra and open a CA ticket.
